name: Alpha Networks Inc
summary: Alpha Networks Inc. is a global technology company dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and support of a wide array of networking solutions. Its comprehensive product range covers both wired and wireless communication technologies. For local and metropolitan area networks (LAN/MAN), offerings include infrastructure for data centers, enterprise campuses, small businesses, carrier access, and industrial Ethernet applications. In the realm of wireless broadband, the company delivers various products, such as mobile and fixed wireless access solutions, alongside general wireless networking equipment. Furthermore, Alpha Networks diversifies its portfolio with digital multimedia devices like IP cameras, and sophisticated mobile enterprise solutions including radar sensors. The company was established in 2003 and operates primarily from its headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
